title: Planned change: a customer with over 100 documents loads 100 at a time
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
  • Customer X has more than 100 lines on A/R Aging Collection (write the count down).
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/R Aging Collection" in the left list.
  3. Read customer X's count in brackets.
  4. Open customer X's group.
  5. Count the lines shown before scrolling further.
  6. Scroll to the end of customer X's group.
  7. Count all its lines.
  8. Read the line after its last document.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

  • Step 3 (unchanged from before the release): The count is the full number of lines.

Step 5:

  • PRD v12, S1-R8, quoted: “A/R Summary, A/P Summary, A/R Collection and A/P Unpaid Invoices show 30 customers or vendors at a time, and the next 30 load as the user scrolls down, as today. There are no page buttons. A/R Detail and A/P Detail show each bucket's first 100 lines, then load more as the user scrolls (S4-R4). Paging never repeats or skips a customer, vendor or row, in any sort. On A/R Collection and A/P Unpaid Invoices, an open customer or vendor shows its first 100 documents, then the next 100 as the user scrolls; its document count, its subtotals, the Totals row and the exports always cover all of its documents. The documents of an open customer or vendor may all arrive from the server in one request; this rule sets only how many are shown at a time.”
  • Step 5 (our restatement, not the PRD's words): 100 lines first (production showed all of them).
  • Step 7 (our restatement, not the PRD's words): Every line is there; the total equals the count.
  • Step 8 (unchanged from before the release): "Total for" customer X covers every line.
  • Related existing case: S1-21 C1062570 (https://shopview.testrail.io/index.php?/cases/view/1062570); S1-22 C1062571 (https://shopview.testrail.io/index.php?/cases/view/1062571). This case checks the same planned change from the before-the-release side.

Why this matters: Paging must not hide any of a customer's debt.

SOURCE: A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter PRD (Confluence 947650561) v12, 12 Nov 2026, S1-R8. V1 behaviour before the change: ShopView/shopview at fc08f23 (production v26.45.3), app/src/components/ts/reporting/accounts-receivable/AgingCollectionReport.vue:111-138; app/src/components/ts/reporting/accounts-receivable/AgingCollectionReport.vue:91-93; app/src/components/ts/reporting/accounts-receivable/AgingCollectionReport.vue:140-163.

This is the expected behaviour as per the A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter PRD (Confluence 947650561) v12, 12 Nov 2026, S1-R8, for epic SV-11315; the V1 behaviour it changes is recorded in AR-AP-V1-BASELINE.md (INV-113). Last checked against build v26.45.4-b8c04e2 (staging) on 11/12/2026.

AUTOMATION: READY
